description: This file defines a custom UI component named SlidingTabLayout, used in conjunction with ViewPager to display a scrollable set of tabs with customizable colors, layouts, and interactions. It manages tab views, color schemes, and synchronizes with page changes.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom horizontal scroll view that displays tabs linked to a ViewPager, providing visual feedback and customization options for tab appearance and behavior.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface to customize indicator and divider colors for tabs.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A nested component responsible for the visual rendering of tab indicators and dividers (not fully shown in the source snippet).

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView styled as a tab for use when a custom tab layout is not provided.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Iterates over the ViewPager's adapter to create and add tab views, inflating custom layouts if specified.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the HorizontalScrollView to ensure the selected tab is visible, accounting for current position and offset.
